verse.text: Now that I am old and gray, do not abandon me, O God. Let me proclaim your power to this new generation, your mighty miracles to all who come after me.

video.title: Who Is Your Legacy For? | Psalm 71:18

reflection: You don't have to wait until you're 'old and gray' to start pointing your kids toward God — every bedtime prayer, every honest answer about a hard day, every 'I messed up, let's pray about it' moment is you proclaiming His power to your own new generation. Legacy isn't a grand speech; it's the accumulation of small, faithful days your kids happen to be watching. Ask God today for one ordinary moment to turn into a story your kids will still be telling their own kids.
